title: C link: TDMA beacon codec (beacon.c) per spec 02a 2a.2
description: Child of b7z9.60 (C slice): lichen/subsys/lichen has no TDMA beacon format at all (rg beacon_sig|setup_window|occupied_time|channel_mask|rx_chains = zero). Create lichen/subsys/lichen/link/beacon.{c,h} mirroring python/src/lichen/rpl/tdma_beacon.py and rust lichen-core tdma_beacon.rs: 24-byte header (epoch u32 BE@0, num_slots u8@4, sfn@5, timestamp@9, flags@13 with reserved mask 0xF0, rx_chains@14, setup_window u16@15, occupied_time u16@17, guard@19, channel_mask u32@20), signature_bytes/signed_data/cbor_options extraction (48-byte trailing Schnorr48, MIN 72). Host CTest lichen/tests/tdma_beacon consuming ccp_beacon_format.json beacon_wire_example header_hex + reserved-flag/short-buffer rejections.
